title: Marlowe & Finch Delivery Guarantee: Late Delivery Terms under Delivery Claims
content:
Under Delivery Claims, a guaranteed delivery counts as late from a set number of calendar days after the promised delivery date, carrier guarantees are suspended for a yearly peak period, and a late-delivery goodwill amount is set per claim type.

| Claim type | Late from (calendar days after the promised delivery date) | Guarantee suspended from | Guarantee suspended through | Late-delivery goodwill amount (USD) | When the Goodwill Credit caps are reached |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Late Delivery Claim | 1 | 27 November (11-27) | 24 December (12-24) | 10.00 | no compensation |
| Delivered Not Received Claim | 0 (not a late claim) | not applicable | not applicable | 0.00 | not applicable |
| Lost in Transit Claim | 0 (not a late claim) | not applicable | not applicable | 0.00 | not applicable |
| Damaged in Transit Claim | 0 (not a late claim) | not applicable | not applicable | 0.00 | not applicable |
| Missing Item Claim | 0 (not a late claim) | not applicable | not applicable | 0.00 | not applicable |
| Wrong Item Claim | 0 (not a late claim) | not applicable | not applicable | 0.00 | not applicable |

## Terms of the guarantee

1. A guaranteed delivery is late when it is delivered 1 or more calendar days after its promised delivery date. Delivered on the promised date, it is not late.
2. Every year, carrier delivery guarantees are suspended from 27 November through 24 December, both days included; the period is fixed by the promised delivery date.
3. The late-delivery goodwill amount of a Late Delivery Claim is 10.00 USD; the other claim types carry 0.00 because they are not late claims.
4. Where the Goodwill Credit caps are reached on a Late Delivery Claim, no compensation is given in their place.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Promised delivery date | Delivered date | Late? | Promise inside the suspension period? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14 March | 14 March | no (0 days) | no |
| 14 March | 15 March | yes (1 day) | no |
| 26 November | 28 November | yes (2 days) | no — 26 November is the day before the period |
| 27 November | 30 November | yes (3 days) | yes — first day of the period |
| 24 December | 27 December | yes (3 days) | yes — last day of the period |
| 25 December | 26 December | yes (1 day) | no — the day after the period |
